records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Total Net sales for the three months ended March 31, 2022 increased $1,112 million, or 23.0%, to $5,949 million compared to prior year.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: This increase was driven by higher demand in hardware, services and software and includes the contribution from the acquisition of Sirius.
